It is now a haven to [[corsair]]s. Strangely, there is a regular shipping route from here to [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan|Kamadan]]. {{Quotation|game| The settlement at Dajkah Inlet was destroyed long ago by a [[Centaur]] raid, but that hasn't kept the [[corsairs]] and smugglers out. Now a busy base of operations for any number of dastardly deeds, you best mind your manners in Dajkah, before the townfolk there decide to educate you on corsair etiquette. }} ==Getting there== Once the [[Consulate Docks]] mission has been completed, [[Dockmaster Ahlaro]] in [[Kamadan]] will have a new dialogue option to take characters to this location.
